name: Travel Vlog
description: Cinematic travel storytelling with location establishing shots, immersive walking sequences, and atmospheric closes. Targets wanderlust audiences.
voice_style: reflective, adventurous, cinematic narration — dreamy travel documentary energy
music_mood: cinematic ambient, world music, lo-fi travel, orchestral swell

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Nobody talks about how expensive it actually is to travel full-time — until now.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Golden hour aerial drone shot of coastal city, palm trees silhouetted against orange sky, passport and plane ticket close-up
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow aerial drone-style zoom, cinematic slow pan across horizon, macro close-up on passport/ticket
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: golden hour backlit sun in frame, warm orange and pink sky, silhouette foreground elements, lens flare
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Golden hour drone aesthetic is travel content gold; backlit sun in frame creates iconic hook shot; passport detail adds narrative setup

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: This city surprised me. The food costs less than my grocery bill back home, the WiFi is faster, and I found a co-working space that costs $15 a week.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Walking through narrow cobblestone streets, cafe terrace overlooking city square, person working on laptop at outdoor co-working space, market stalls passing by
scene_sequence.camera_movement: walking POV tracking shot, smooth glide through streets, panning across cafe scene, static medium for co-working moment
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: dappled sunlight through trees, warm Mediterranean tones, market stall colorful lighting, ambient cafe glow
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Walking POV is immersive and proven for travel; mix in static held shots between movement for cinematic breathing room

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The real cost breakdown: accommodation $28 a night, food $12 a day, transport $4. Total: $44 a day — that's $1,320 a month to live somewhere incredible.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Money being counted on bed, accommodation interior tour, street food being purchased, scooter driving through town, receipts and budget app on phone
scene_sequence.camera_movement: flat lay overhead for money counting, smooth pan through accommodation, tracking shot of scooter ride
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright natural daylight for accommodation, street market warm tones, phone screen glow for budget app
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Flat lay money counting is a satisfying TikTok format; accommodation tour should be clean and aspirational

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: I'll drop the full budget guide in my bio. Follow along — next month I'm doing this in three cities for under $2,000.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Sunset beach scene, person looking at camera smiling, plane taking off overhead, text overlay 'Part 2 coming...', wave rolling
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic wide shot on beach, static medium on person smiling, slow-motion plane overhead
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm sunset golden hour, backlit silhouette option, orange sky reflecting on water, lens flare on sun
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Sunset beach closing is a proven travel outro; plane overhead adds forward-momentum narrative hook
